messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager fired for service=inference-gateway-usw2 - condition=High5xxRate(10m) threshold=10% current=18.4% - triggered at 2026-03-14T02:45:10Z - alert_id=AG-5099 - grafana: https://grafana.redwood.local/alerts/AG-5099
pagerbot: PagerDuty incident 8421 created -> escalation policy: inference-oncall -> assigned: mike (oncall). Please ack in PD.
mike (oncall): Acked the PD incident. I'm taking initial triage. Checking dashboards now.
sarah (sre): saw the spike too — error pattern looks like 502/504 from upstream KV cache + gateway 502s. p95 latency up ~300ms.
chen (eng-runtime): copying grafana panels: 5xx rate per region: us-west2=18.4%, us-east1=1.2%, eu-west1=0.9%. KV cache miss rate spiked ~x5 correlating with a deploy ~02:41 UTC.
mike (oncall): thanks. Any active deploys around 02:40? devon?
devon (prod-support): not from prod-deploy pipeline AFAIK. I see a canary job finished at 02:39 but the canary was in eu-west1.
sarah (sre): dropping a quick runbook checklist: 1) identify recent changes 2) check pod restart counts 3) try routing traffic away from us-west2 4) scale gateway pool 5) if needed, restart sidecar KV pods.
mike (oncall): running pod checks

mike (oncall): ```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference-gateway -o wide
# gateway-usw2-0   Running  4/4  2d  10.0.1.45
# gateway-usw2-1   Running  4/4  2d  10.0.1.47
# gateway-usw2-2   Running  2/4  5m  10.0.1.52  (restarts: 12)
```

sarah (sre): gateway-usw2-2 restart count is suspicious. Which container is failing?
chen (eng-runtime): looks like kv-sidecar crashlooping on a specific node. Logs show TLS handshake timeout to kvcache-backend.
mike (oncall): tailing logs: ```
kubectl -n inference logs gateway-usw2-2 -c kv-sidecar --since=10m
# 02:40:01 WARN  connect timeout to 10.2.3.5:8443
# 02:40:03 ERROR failed auth handshake: EOF
# 02:40:05 ERROR upstream closed connection
```
devon (prod-support): can we route around the node quickly? Suggest cordon the node and scale up gateway replica count to absorb traffic.
chen (eng-runtime): agree. Also we can flip routing policy to prefer us-east1 fallback (read-only tolerant) — trigger routing switch.
mike (oncall): executing mitigation step 1: scale replicas to 6 from 3 in us-west2, and add routing weight to us-east1 (30%).

mike (oncall): ```
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/gateway-usw2 --replicas=6
redwood-routing-cli set-weight inference-gateway --region=us-east1 --weight=0.3
```
sarah (sre): scaling started. kubectl shows new pods provisioning. I'll watch error rate.

sarah (sre): graph update: after scaling + routing change, 5xx rate dropped from 18.4% -> 6.7% within 2m. p50 lat improved. Still seeing occasional 502s from gateway-usw2-2 node.
chen (eng-runtime): kv-sidecar on that node still failing. We should cordon + drain node then reboot sidecar host, or restart the kvcache-backend via statefulset. Which approach is faster?
mike (oncall): cordon+drain and restart pods on other nodes. I'll coordinate with infra.
devon (prod-support): looping infra: @infra-oncall can you confirm any noisy network maintenance in us-west2?

elaine (cs): customer check-in — I'm seeing a ticket flagged by a PM: "short user-facing 502s in app" - small subset of customers impacted (approx 2% request failure to particular feature). I'll prepare a customer status note pending mitigation.
chen (eng-runtime): running controlled restart for kv-backend statefulset (staggered): ```
kubectl -n statefulset rollout restart kvcache-backend-usw2 --timeout=5m
```

pagerbot: PagerDuty note: incident 8421 acknowledged by mike. Notifications suppressed to further escalation tier for 10m.

mike (oncall): drain initiated for node ip-10-0-5-18.usw2

mike (oncall): ```
kubectl drain ip-10-0-5-18 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
# pods evicted, gateway-usw2-2 rescheduled to node ip-10-0-7-21
```
sarah (sre): new pod node looks healthy, restart counts reset. Monitoring 5xxs...

sarah (sre): update: 5xx rate now stable at 1.1% for last 5m. p50 latency back to baseline.
devon (prod-support): confirm no impacts to batch inference customers? Metrics show no backlog growth.
elaine (cs): sending brief to impacted PMs: "We experienced a transient spike in 5xxs originating from a KV sidecar TLS handshake issue in us-west2. We routed traffic and scaled to mitigate; error rate returned to baseline. Follow-up OTR at 10:00 UTC"

chen (eng-runtime): creating a follow-up task to investigate TLS renegotiation failures between gateway sidecars and kvcache: https://linear.redwood/s/INC-5099-investigate-kv-tls
mike (oncall): I'll keep incident open for postmortem notes. For now, incident severity reduced. Marking as "mitigated" but not resolved.

mike (oncall): :thumbsup: good job team. I'll handoff to sarah for post-incident writeup and follow-up tasks.
sarah (sre): taking handoff. I'll add timeline + RCA draft. Follow-up sprint ticket created.

incident-bot: Incident 8421 state=mitigated - mitigation_time=2026-03-14T02:52:48Z - responder=mike (oncall)

mike (oncall): closing PD acknowledgement window. final note: mitigation actions = scaled gateway, routed 30% to us-east1, drained and reprovisioned affected node, restarted kvcache-backend. Follow-up items assigned to eng-runtime.

sarah (sre): I'll file postmortem and tag infra and eng-runtime. ETA prelim RCA in 24h.

elaine (cs): thank you — I'll update customers after RCA.

pagerbot: Incident 8421 -> status changed to "Mitigated" in PagerDuty.

chen (eng-runtime): quick note: no rollback required. We'll monitor TLS metrics overnight.

mike (oncall): signing off, handing rotation to next oncall at 03:00 UTC.

sarah (sre): acknowledged handoff. Thanks everyone for quick response. :sparkles:
